_comment: COUNT 4, DERIVED RATHER THAN PICKED (corrected in review of #286).
A heap is 5-11 wide, so a mean radius near 4 covers about 49 columns. At the count of 14 this
first shipped with, that is ~686 columns against a chunk's 256 - 2.7x COVERAGE, an unbroken
carpet with no clean ground anywhere. That defeats two things at once: the stain is meant to be
visible around a heap's rim, and this biome is in the encroachment tag precisely so grass is
CONTESTED on the clean ground - of which there would have been none.
Every other scatter in this mod sits well under 1x: rubble_pile is 6 x ~21 = 0.49x,
mechanical_waste_pile is 2. Four heaps x 49 columns is 0.77x - denser than the yard's rubble,
which is right for the region whose identity the scatter has to carry, without becoming a floor.
